name: ev_chargers
description: Convenience scripts for fanning out to each microservice. Each service under services/* remains an independent npm package (its own package-lock.json), so this is not an npm workspace root.

scripts.typecheck: npm run --prefix services/api-gateway typecheck && npm run --prefix services/charger-service typecheck && npm run --prefix services/location-service typecheck && npm run --prefix services/status-service typecheck
scripts.build: npm run --prefix services/api-gateway build && npm run --prefix services/charger-service build && npm run --prefix services/location-service build && npm run --prefix services/status-service build
scripts.test: npm test --prefix services/api-gateway && npm test --prefix services/charger-service && npm test --prefix services/location-service && npm test --prefix services/status-service
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/api-gateway && npm install --prefix services/charger-service && npm install --prefix services/location-service && npm install --prefix services/status-service
